name: penrix-coding-core
description: Non-programmer-owner coding workflow: intent grounding, LLM contract reality checks, runtime evidence gates, and plain-language handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Intent grounding, reality checks, runtime evidence, and owner handoff
interface.longDescription: A coding-agent workflow for a non-programmer product owner. It keeps product decisions with the owner, technical decisions with the coding agent, re-verifies LLM-generated task contracts against repository reality, requires honest runtime evidence, and reports outcomes in plain language.
